findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 2 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 26 questions numbered 1-26; by section: 2.1 2, 2.2 1, 2.2.1 2, 2.4.1 1, 2.3.2 2, 2.5.2 2, 2.5.3 1, u-spin-quantum-number-s 1, 2.6 1, 2.6.3 1, 2.7 1, 2.7.2 2, 2.7.4 1, 2.7.5 1, 2.8 1, 2.8.2 1, 2.9.1 2, 2.9.2 1, 2.10 1, 2.11.1 1.

The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
